description: Human review, canonical hashing, and Sepolia anchoring. Creates the canonical JSON and record hashing library, reviewer auth cookie, review decision API, anchor API, and the reviewer UI page. Also creates tests/canonical.test.ts. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps: Create src/lib/hash/canonical.ts: export function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string — recursive implementation: null/primitive -> JSON.stringify(value); array -> '[' + elements.map(canonicalJson).join(',') + ']'; object -> sort keys, map to '"key":value', join with commas, wrap in braces. Exactly as in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §4 skeleton. No whitespace anywhere.

Create src/lib/hash/record.ts: import { keccak256, toUtf8Bytes } from 'ethers'; import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'; import { canonicalJson } from './canonical'. Exports: sha256Hex(s: string): string; recordHash(record: unknown): string (keccak256(toUtf8Bytes(canonicalJson(record)))); batchIdHash(batchCode: string): string (keccak256(toUtf8Bytes(batchCode))). Also export buildRecord(params: BuildRecordParams): VerificationRecord following the VerificationRecord shape in design.md: schema='proofchain/1', batch_code, claims sorted, run_number, ai_recommendation, evidence array sorted by sha256, findings_digest (sha256 of canonicalJson of findings sorted by finding_id), carbon_digest (sha256 of canonicalJson of carbon_result or '' if null), decision, override_confirmed, decided_at. The reviewer_note is NOT included in the record.

Create tests/canonical.test.ts: (1) key order independence: canonicalJson({b:1, a:{d:2, c:3}}) === '{"a":{"c":3,"d":2},"b":1}'; (2) array order preserved: canonicalJson({x:[3,1,2]}) === '{"x":[3,1,2]}'; (3) stable known vector: build a VerificationRecord with fixed inputs, call recordHash(), assert the hex matches a precomputed expected value; (4) canonicalJson is pure — calling twice with same input returns same string.

Create src/lib/auth/reviewer.ts: (1) HMAC-SHA256 cookie implementation — signCookie(expiry: number): string computes HMAC-SHA256 of 'reviewer:{expiry}' using SESSION_SECRET; (2) verifyCookie(cookie: string): boolean parses '<expiry>.<sig>', checks expiry > Date.now()/1000, recomputes HMAC, uses crypto.timingSafeEqual to compare; (3) export function requireReviewer(request: NextRequest): void — reads 'pc_reviewer' cookie, calls verifyCookie, throws fail('UNAUTHORIZED', ..., 401) if invalid.

Create src/app/api/auth/reviewer/route.ts (REPLACE the stub from FEAT-002): POST handler — parse body { passcode: string }; compare with env.REVIEWER_PASSCODE using crypto.timingSafeEqual (pad to equal length); if match: set httpOnly cookie 'pc_reviewer=<expiry>.<sig>', sameSite=lax, secure in production, maxAge=28800 (8h), return {success:true}; else return fail('UNAUTHORIZED', 'Invalid passcode', 401).

Create src/app/api/batches/[id]/review/route.ts: POST — (1) requireReviewer(request); (2) parse body { decision: 'VERIFIED'|'REJECTED'|'NEEDS_EVIDENCE', reviewer_note: string, override_confirmed?: boolean }; (3) validate reason >= 10 chars; (4) load latest COMPLETED verification_run for this batch; (5) check no existing review_decision for this run_id (DECISION_EXISTS); (6) if decision=VERIFIED and any finding has severity=high and result=FLAG: require override_confirmed=true or return error asking for override; (7) build VerificationRecord via buildRecord(); (8) compute record_hash via recordHash(); (9) insert review_decisions row with record_json, record_hash, decided_at=now(); (10) update batch status to match decision (VERIFIED/REJECTED/NEEDS_EVIDENCE); (11) appendAudit('decision_recorded', { decision, record_hash }); (12) return { decisionId, record_hash }.

Create src/lib/chain/abi.ts: export const REGISTRY_ABI = [...] — copy the exact human-readable ABI array from docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §3. Include recordVerification, getRecordCount, getLatest, getRecord, isRecorded, isRecorder, and VerificationRecorded event.

Create src/lib/chain/anchor.ts: export async function anchorDecision(decisionId: string): Promise<BlockchainRecordRow>. Implement the algorithm from docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §4 anchor.ts section: (1) check blockchain_records for existing row by review_decision_id -> return if found (idempotent); (2) load review_decision including record_json and record_hash; (3) assert recordHash(record_json) === record_hash (tamper check); (4) create ethers Provider with env.SEPOLIA_RPC_URL; create Signer from env.RECORDER_PRIVATE_KEY; (5) create Contract instance with REGISTRY_ABI; (6) compute batchId = batchIdHash(batch_code); (7) check registry.isRecorded(batchId, recordHash) first — if already on-chain but no DB row, log warning; (8) appendAudit('anchor_submitted'); (9) call registry.recordVerification(batchId, recordHash, statusToChain(decision)); (10) await tx.wait(1, 120000); (11) if receipt.status !== 1: appendAudit('anchor_failed'); throw fail('ANCHOR_FAILED'...); (12) insert blockchain_records { review_decision_id, chain_id=env.CHAIN_ID, contract_address=env.REGISTRY_ADDRESS, transaction_hash, record_hash, block_number }; (13) appendAudit('anchor_succeeded', { tx_hash, block_number }); (14) return the inserted row.

Create src/app/api/batches/[id]/anchor/route.ts: POST — (1) requireReviewer(request); (2) load latest review_decision for batchId; (3) if none: fail('NO_DECISION'); (4) call anchorDecision(decision.id); (5) return { txHash, blockNumber, explorerUrl: env.EXPLORER_BASE_URL + '/tx/' + txHash }.

Create src/app/batches/[id]/review/page.tsx: client component. Shows: (1) AI recommendation badge (colour-coded); (2) recommendation_ceiling badge; (3) if ceiling < recommendation: explains why capped; (4) findings summary grouped as in batch detail page; (5) reviewer login form if unauthenticated (POST /api/auth/reviewer); (6) when authenticated: decision radio (VERIFIED/REJECTED/NEEDS_EVIDENCE), reviewer_note textarea (>=10 chars validation), override checkbox (shown only when decision=VERIFIED and any high-severity FLAG exists), Submit button (POST /api/batches/:id/review); (7) after decision: 'Anchor on Sepolia' button (POST /api/batches/:id/anchor) with loading state; shows tx hash, block number, and Sepolia explorer link on success; (8) all loading/empty/error states per NFR-11.
Run npx vitest run (canonical.test.ts must pass) and npm run build.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run — tests/canonical.test.ts passes with known stable vector
requireReviewer throws UNAUTHORIZED when cookie is absent or expired
POST /api/batches/:id/review returns DECISION_EXISTS on second submission for same run
anchorDecision returns existing blockchain_records row on second call (idempotent)
Reviewer cookie is httpOnly and not accessible from client-side JavaScript
